A '''[[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassin]]''' was a former servant of [[Darth Ekkage]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during her tenure on the [[Dark Council]]. At some point, the assassin became disillusioned with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of the [[The Force/Legends|Force]] and sought refuge with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], thus betraying Ekkage and the [[Sith infiltrators]] and leading to their imprisonment in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] secret [[Belsavis prison|prison]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="Ekkage" />
